news.title: Treasury Buybacks and the Convenience Yield | St. Louis Fed
news.summary: Summary: US long-term Treasury yields have risen sharply due to multiple factors, including higher expected short-term rates, a larger term premium, and a structural decline in the convenience yield—the premium investors historically accept for the safety and liquidity of Treasuries.
